_readme: 立绘 prompt 模板。base 是 Becky 的固定设定（别删挑染/配饰/不笑/全身/鞋），outfits 按底图识别出的场景挑。{outfit} 由候选替换进去。改这个文件不用重启 DSH。
base: {shot}, {pose}, cold calm expression, no smile, half-lidded eyes, beautiful detailed face, large expressive blue eyes, delicate sharp eyebrows, chin-length black bob cut with grey-blue highlight strands in the hair on both sides, left ear silver hoop earring, thin leather cord on right wrist, slim figure, {outfit}, {extra}, face clearly visible with sharp detailed facial features, {framing}, plain light grey background, detailed anime illustration, clean lineart, soft cel shading, high quality
